subject: MAP: Orion Analytics — GCP Private Offer evaluation & billing checkpoint
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@orion-analytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed MAP for Orion's GCP private offer — evaluation milestones & billing path

Hi Sanjay —

Following our demo last week, attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP) to get Orion to production with the Redwood inference runtime via a GCP private offer. High-level milestones inside the sheet:

- Week 0–2: Technical onboarding & perf baseline (shared test prompts, 1-week POC)
- Week 2–4: Security/compliance checklist (SOC2 scoping + limited audit artifacts)
- Week 4–6: Pricing & billing agreement (private offer terms, billing routing)
- Week 6–8: Contract signature + Marketplace private offer activation

Two quick clarifications we need from your side to lock dates: procurement contact for PO routing, and whether you prefer Marketplace invoicing (GCP invoice) or direct invoicing to Orion finance. Our standard approach for private offers is to mirror the Marketplace billing (so charges appear on your GCP bill) but we can support alternate invoicing if required — there are some additional steps for commitment-based billing.

Attached: Orion_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft).

Next step: can you confirm the procurement email and your target PO issuance date? If possible, we’ll aim to have a private-offer draft to legal by 2026-03-12.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.ai]

Attachment: Orion_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@orion-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@orion-analytics.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP for Orion's GCP private offer — evaluation milestones & billing path

Thanks Karthik — quick responses from our side:

- Procurement: Priya Menon (cc'ed) handles private offers and PO routing.
- Billing preference: ideally via GCP Marketplace invoice so the costs flow to our existing cloud billing. Can you confirm Redwood supports Marketplace private-offer billing to our GCP invoice ID? If there are blockers we may consider direct invoice.
- Legal: our counsel needs ~10 business days for standard review; if you can get a private-offer draft and SOW in the next two weeks that helps.

Also: we have an internal compliance checkpoint the week of 3/8 — they want a short checklist for data residency and audit log retention (not a full SOC2 package yet). Can you provide the minimal artifacts we should hand to compliance?

Appreciate the timeline — can we tentatively target: POC start 3/1, compliance checkpoint 3/8, contract sign 3/19? Priya — any conflicts?

Best,
Sanjay
CTO, Orion Analytics

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Proposed MAP for Orion's GCP private offer — evaluation milestones & billing path

Looping you both in —

Summary of asks from Sanjay/Priya:
- Confirm Marketplace billing flow for GCP private offer (they want charges on their GCP invoice).
- Provide minimal compliance artifacts for the week-of-3/8 checkpoint (data residency, log retention window, point contacts).
- Produce a private-offer draft and SOW for legal review by 3/10 to meet a 3/19 signature target.

Notes / proposed replies:
- Billing: Redwood supports Marketplace private-offer billing to a customer GCP invoice ID. There are two routing options: (A) Marketplace invoice (charges on GCP bill, standard) or (B) Redwood direct invoice (requires PO + billing setup). For (A) we need Priya to confirm the GCP billing account ID and the Marketplace account owner email. For (B) we’ll circulate invoice terms and net payment window.
- Compliance artifacts: attach lightweight checklist I put together and the integration checklist for the POC. Grace — can you confirm what single-page artifacts compliance will accept for the checkpoint?

I updated the MAP (attached) with the proposed dates Sanjay suggested and added a billing checkpoint row. Attaching: redwood_private_offer_ACME_draft.pdf (private-offer template) and gcp-integration-checklist.xlsx.

If you agree I’ll send a one-pager to Priya today and request the GCP billing account ID + procurement PO cadence.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_private_offer_ACME_draft.pdf (PDF, 110KB); gcp-integration-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 18KB)

Subject: Re: MAP: Orion Analytics — GCP Private Offer evaluation & billing checkpoint

Neha / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the updated materials. Priya confirmed the GCP billing account ID (sent via internal channel) and procurement confirmed they can accept Marketplace private-offer billing.

We are aligned on the proposed timeline:
- 2026-03-01: POC kickoff (technical onboarding)
- 2026-03-08: Compliance checkpoint (single-page artifacts accepted)
- 2026-03-19: Target signature (legal review complete)

Next steps from Orion: Priya will upload the PO placeholder after legal review and share the PO number. We will also provide the GCP billing account ID to your provisioning team. Please share the final private-offer draft and SOW by 2026-03-05 so our counsel has the full doc set for review.

Once we have the PO number I will confirm activation timing. Looking forward —

Sanjay Rao
CTO, Orion Analytics
